glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 宀 + phonetic 舄.
senses: [xiě] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to place; to displace; to relocate
[xiě] to write (with a pen, brush, etc.); to write down
[xiè] alternative form of 瀉 (“to pour out; to leak”)
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 寫; s_page_origin explains the simplified 写.
